title: 5.2.2 Swinging Pendulum — Worked Example
description: A rod hangs from a fixed anchor using a HingeJoint. Click to give it a push.

steps.title: Read the example
steps.instructions: A static anchor and a dynamic rod, joined by a HingeJoint — that makes them rotate around the anchor.
hints: The hinge position is set by the anchor's position; the rod just hangs off it.

steps.title: Longer rod
steps.instructions: Change the rod's height from 120 to 220 and run. It swings more slowly because its moment of inertia grew.

steps.title: Chain two pendulums
steps.instructions: Add a second rod hinged to the first rod's bottom end. Congrats: you just built a double pendulum.
hints: new HingeJoint(rod, rod2) — the second rod hangs from the first.

requirements.title: Use a static anchor
requirements.description: At least one 'static' sprite to anchor the hinge

requirements.title: Enable gravity
requirements.description: world.gravity.y is set so the pendulum swings
